system.description: Two small magical motes float around you. Give them 2 traits such as: annoying—melancholic—mesmerizing—petty—troublesome—whimsical. You can sacrifice one to have it act independently, making a story roll if needed. They return each session.

notes.description: You could send one to assist an ally, distract a foe, light the way, or even pass a message to someone. The story roll here is about how effective they are, it doesn't prompt an impact move.
